pr_title: Deferred: Stop inventing jQuery.when() resolution values
pr_comments: @gibson042, thanks for your PR! By analyzing the history of the files in this pull request, we identified @markelog, @jaubourg and @dmethvin to be potential reviewers.

issue_context.title: empty when resolves with 1 undefined argument in jQuery 3 (was 0 arguments in jQuery 2)
issue_context.body:
### Description ###
I use dynamic array of deferreds to load 0 to N things and then loop through the arguments in the done callback. Upgrading to jQuery 3.1.1 from 2.2.4 and now my code breaks :(

### Link to test case ###
Minimal test case is call $.when with no arguments, so it should resolve with no arguments too...

2.2.4 - https://jsfiddle.net/nuzy6b43/ - This will correctly have 0 arguments in the done callback
3.1.1 - https://jsfiddle.net/4qys5duk/ - This will incorrectly have 1 argument in the done callback

review_comments: What's the reason for this change?
Consistency with the preceding block, which also effects size reduction (reuse of the `.apply( undefined, [ value ]…` pattern is good for compression).
